book.title: MUSELU WAPAMA WA YESU woolebiwa ni Luka

content: Zakeyu Namakoha-musoko
Yesu ahifiya oZheriko, aviraga muluwani mule.
Mwahikala muthu mmohi oreela mmohi eeriwa Zakeyu, mpogo a anamakoha-musoko.
Oofunesesaga omoona Yesu baani, mbwenye kaakwanihilege ni winjiva wa athu, vowi aali ookwiva.
Nuwindo, ahithamagelaga osogolo, ogwela munthazani wi amoone, vowi Yesu aavira vevale vaaligiye.
Yesu agafiyile mburo olene, ahisugwaga odhulu, omwiirela: “Zakeyu, kita mowaaguva. Vowi soofuneya peeno wi Gikale vade vaawo.”
Oliye ahikitaga mowaaguva, omwaakela ni ohagalala.
Ateene yoonilege nde, yomwaabaga yiiraga: “Oliye ofiyedhe vade va ‘namathega.’”
Nuwindo Zakeyu ahiimelaga, omwiirela Nabwiya: “Ginogawa vaari dhoreela dhaaga gaavahe oorabula. Akala gihimwiiyela muthu, ginomuwelihedha dila nayi okwaranya dhamwiyelimi.”
Yesu ahimwiirelaga: “Peeno ovulumusa ohufiya vade va, vowi ola teto di mwaana a Abarahamu.
Vowi, Mwaana a Muthu odheele wasayela ni wavulumusa orimeela.”
Musibe wa Korowa Kumi
Yesu ahawogelaga musibe mmohi wa alene yamwiiwaga Oliye nde dhawogigiye, vowi aali vakuukuvi ni oZheruzalemi, mwa ela aliwa yoobuwela wi Omwene wa Mulugu weere ofiya mowaaguva.
Nuwindo Yesu wiira: “Muthu mmohi a nlogo noovuweya ahidhowa elabo emohiya woolapa wi avahiwe omwene endo awelewo.
Ahawiithanaga amwiimeleli aaye kumi, waavaha korowa kumi, wiira: ‘Mmwiiregena nagooso ofiyedha ginawelimiwo.’
“Mbwenye athu a elabo ele yoomugana, yahaaruma mundduli mwaaye arumiwi wi yamwiirele: ‘Hiyo kannafuna wi anithongege.’
“Vano oliye aweliliyewo, agavahiwe omwene. Ahawiithanaga amwiimeleli alene yaavahiliye korowa, wi anone dhipurilisu.
“Ahidhaaga owambeela, wiira: ‘Nabwiyani, korowa dheenyu nde, gipurilemo dhimohi kumi.’
“Nabwiye ahimwaakulaga, wiira: ‘Dhihikala pama, oli mwiimeleli apama; mwaha wi ohooneyiha ororomeleya ni dhooyeva, onodha waathonge maluwa kumi.’
“Ahidhaaga mwiimeleli anabiili, eeraga: ‘Nabwiyani, korowa dheenyu nde, gipurilemo dhimohi tanu.’
“Nabwiye ahimwiirela teto ni olena: ‘Onodha waathonge maluwa matanu.’
“Odha vevale mwiimeleli mmohiwa, eeraga: ‘Nabwiyani, korowa yeenyu ela, galogohiliimi gamagile mu lesoni.
Miyo gowuwoovani, vowi nyo muli muthu oorusa. Munovenyihavo elene muhuhelilinyuvo, ni ohadda nde muhudhalilinyu.’
“Nabwiye ahimwaakulaga, wiira: ‘Mwiimeleli abure! Ni mwaha wa vamulomoni vaawo ginowukona. Wahinona wi miyo gili muthu oorusa, ginovenyihavo gihihelilimivo ni ohadda dhihidhalilimi.
Ki mwahaya bwa ddi odhe ohuhelege obanko korowa yaaga, wi miyo gawelawo gaakele mowenjedhedheya?’
“Vano ahawiirelaga ale yoonelaga: ‘Mwaakeni korowaya mumvahe olene winna kumi.’
“Aliwa yahimwaakulaga: ‘Nabwiyani, oliye ohukanna dhimohi kumi!’
“Oliye ahimwaakulaga: ‘Miyo Ginowuwaaddelani wi olene winna, onowenjedhedhiwa; mbwenye ole ohinna, elene yiniyena onowaakiwa.
Mbwenye amwiiddani alene yahafunile wi miyo gaathongege aliwa, mwaadhena wuno mwaape vameentoni vaaga!’”
Ovolowa ni Ovuweya
Vano Yesu agawogile nde, ahisogolaga odhowa oZheruzalemi.
Dhahipadduwa wi yaaddamelaga oBetifazha ni oBetaniya, vakuukuvi ni Mwango wa Olivera, ahaarumaga anamasuuza aaye abiili, ahawiirelaga:
“Dhowani mmavade a mmiganoni mwemule, mwavolowaga, munomfwanya buuru agamageleliwe ohunagweliwege ni muthu. Mmutapule, mmudhena.
Mmohiwa onookoheni, eera: ‘Munamutapulela ddi?’ mmwaakule, mwiire: ‘Nabwiya dinamfuna.’”
Vano edhowaga ale yarumiwege, yahimfwanyaga woona mwemule mwawaaddelege Yesu.
Aliwa emutapulaga buuru, anyaya yahiiraga: “Munamutapulela ddi?”
Aliwa yahawaakulaga, wiira: “Mwaha wi Nabwiya dinamfuna.”
Nuwindo yahimudhaagana, otadeela dhoowara vadhulu vabuuru ole, omwiirela Yesu wi amugwele.
Yesu adhowaga, athu yootadeelaga dhoowara mundila.
Vano aaddamelaga mukitakita wa Mwango wa Olivera, anamwinji ateene, anamasuuza, yoolupaga mohagalala, ni madhu omutamala Mulugu, mwaha wa dhotikiniha dhatedhene nde dhooniliwa, yiiraga:
Vevale, maFarizi amohiwa yahimwiirelaga vaari va anamwinji: “Namasuuziha, mwamaalihe anamasuuza eenyu!”
Mbwenye Yesu ahawaakulaga: “Ginowuwaaddelani wi aliwa yamaala, mabwe binakuwege.”
Yesu Onamunddela Zheruzalemi
Yesu aaddamelaga oZheruzalemi, agoonile nluwa, ahinddaga,
eeraga: “Eee! Peeno akalagahi wahinona mwa we weeka, dhego dhinavaha murenddele. Mbwenye dhiinova nda dhili dhologoheya vameentoni vaawo.
Vowi enodha malabo amwiiddani aawo enoorijiwa ni miliddi dhothawelamo, ni waapeliha dhipaddi dhatedhene yuthiyelelena.
Eneere wutolosa we ni anaawo ateene. Vowi kandha nihiyiwa nibwe nimohi vadhulu va nibwe nimohi, mwaha wi kunonile mudhidhi olene wadhiile Mulugu wi oovulumuse.”
Yesu Onowomihedha Nyuba ya Mulugu
Vano, Yesu avolowaga vathaddo va nyuba ya Mulugu, ahambeelaga wawiigara yagulihaga.
Ahawaaddelaga: “Dhihilebiwa: ‘Nyuba yaaga enakale nyuba ya malobelo.’ Mbwenye nyo muhusaddula okala nikungu na ambava.”
Yesu oosuuzihesa munyuba ya Mulugu malabo mateene. Mbwenye apogo a anamakutha, anamasuuziha a malamulo, ni asogoleli a athu yoofuna empe.
Mbwenye kayanna yowiira, vowi athu ateene yoodhiveliwa vanjinjivene yavuruwanaga madhu aaye.
